pack.name: Official Programming / Python Functional Correctness
pack.description: A new immutable coding challenge version that checks one generated Python function in a pinned, isolated local Docker container.

benchmark.name: Software Engineering Essentials
benchmark.description: Version 3 adds one fixed Python function challenge with implementation-owned hidden cases in a restricted Docker harness; version 2 remains available unchanged.

tasks.name: Implement exact user lookup
tasks.prompt: Implement a Python function named find_user(users, user_id). It must return the first user dictionary whose id exactly equals user_id, or None when no user matches. Preserve the input list and its records. Return only the function source code, with no Markdown fences or explanation.

cases.prompt: Implement find_user(users, user_id) in Python. Return the first matching user dictionary when its id exactly equals user_id; return None if absent. Do not mutate users. Return only the function source code, without fences or prose.

tasks.context: The model output is bounded hostile Python source sent only on stdin to a fixed harness. The harness accepts one restricted function, applies fixed hidden cases, and uses no network, mounts, host fallback, or model-selected tests.

criteria.name: Required behavior
criteria.description: Returns the first exact ID match and returns None when no record matches.

criteria.name: Input integrity
criteria.description: Leaves the supplied users list and records unchanged.

execution.requirement: A local Docker daemon and the pinned Python image are required. Model-generated Python source is evaluated by a fixed restricted harness; host execution is prohibited.
execution.notes: Source is bounded and supplied only through stdin. The pinned image runs without network or host mounts under non-root and resource limits.
